App Settings

Ping Calibration

Uses the current browser audio interface channels.

Metronome

AUTOHARP

When enabled, combos like A+Z, W+S, S+X, and J+M act like the usual minor key.
Always have MIDI in keeps external keyboard control active even when the menu MIDI button is off. The menu button then only controls MIDI OUT / output bypass.
Uses held external MIDI notes like QWERTY AUTOHARP. Channel 0 listens omni. Ribbon quantize keeps the middle 33% natural, and uses extra flat/sharp spots for 53-EDO and higher while keeping the natural center at least 20% wide.
Hold MIDI chord keeps the last derived external MIDI chord visible and playable after note release until a new MIDI note change arrives.

Strum Velocity
